in_marathi.name: Anvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Graceful, Beautiful, Knowledgeable
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'anu' meaning 'with' and 'vika' meaning 'knowledge'. The name symbolizes the graceful and beautiful being who is rich in knowledge and wisdom.
